npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-01.htm.text: Priest Shegfield: People of the just Einhasad may express their loyalty to their goddess in many ways. Prove your loyalty by assisting the Temple and you will be given the title "Hands of the Temple" as a reward -- and to inspire others.

links.text: "I want to prove my loyalty to my goddess."

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-02.htm.text: Priest Shegfield: Only if you are wise and strong enough may you perform this duty for the Temple and prove your loyalty to the goddess. Return here after more training. (Only characters level 35 and above are permitted to undertake this quest.)

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-04.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Patience! I was just coming to that. It will not be difficult. Help the people in Floran Village and they will provide you with letters of recommendation. The people who petitioned the Temple for help are Grocer Pano, Warehouse Keeper Sonin and Captain Alex. Ask Alex for more info…

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-05.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Go to Floran Village and bring me letters of recommendation from Pano, Sonin and Alex. Ask Alex for more information.

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-06.html.text: Priest Shegfield: You do not have a letter of recommendation from them all, however. Go to Floran Village and bring me letters of recommendation from Pano, Sonin and Alex. Ask Alex for more information.

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-08.html.text: Priest Shegfield: What are you talking about? Tithing is a holy duty, a sacred obligation, for the people of the goddess, but we do not force it on anyone. The villagers contributed of their own free will... It is admirable that they have continued to do so in the face of hardship. The goddess will…

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-07.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Ah, you have brought all the letters of recommendation. Well done. Hmm... you look like you want to ask me something. What is it?

links.text: "Can the Temple allow them to keep their tithe?"

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30068-01.html.text: Priest Shegfield: How can I help you?

links.text: "I want to know about the last remaining Cruma."

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30068-04.html.text: Priest Shegfield: I already told you about the fate of the Cruma. Your search is in vain, adventurer. I advise you turn your feet onto another path.

Q00191_VainConclusion/30068-01.html.text: Priest Shegfield: How can I help you?

links.text: "I want to know about the last remaining Cruma."

Q00191_VainConclusion/30068-04.html.text: Priest Shegfield: I already told you about the fate of the Cruma. Your search is in vain, adventurer. I advise you turn your feet onto another path.

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-03.htm.text: Priest Shegfield: Very well. Now listen to what I am about to say. Go south from here to Floran Village, a village of poor peasants who lack a lord's protection. Despite their poverty, however, they are still people of the goddess. Please help them.

links.text: "How can I prove that I helped them?"

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-09.html.text: Priest Shegfield: After the creation of the world, there was a great war between the gods, including Shilen and Einhasad. In the aftermath of this conflict, the Giants in their arrogance rebelled against Einhasad and inflicted grievous damage on the Celestial Realm before they were vanquished and t…

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-10.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Now you know the truth of our history. Take this badge, which signifies that you are the Hands of the Temple. It is a sign of your loyalty and devotion to the goddess.

Q00135_TempleExecutor/30068-11.html.text: Priest Shegfield: If you achieve the title of the Feet and the title of the Hands of the Temple, you will be called the Limbs of the Temple. To aspire to be the Feet of the Temple , ask Priest Glyvka . High Priest Sylvain can elevate you to the position of the Hands of the Temple . Once you become …

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30068-02.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Cruma... Where did you hear that name?

links.text: "It was mentioned in an old record of the Giants we recovered from the ruins of the Tower of Cruma."

Q00189_ContractCompletion/30068-03.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Hmm. Unfortunately, the Cruma are extinct. You know of the ancient war between Elves and Humans? At that time, the Cruma became our greatest ally. But we were overwhelmed by the Humans' sheer numbers and forced to retreat. The Cruma fought a valiant rearguard action, giving us tim…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30068-note.text: Priest Shegfield: You are welcome to remain here to rest or meditate, but I am afraid I cannot accept you as a student. Your destiny lies elsewhere. May Einhasad guard your steps and light your path!

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30068.html.text: Priest Shegfield: Welcome to the sacred Temple of Einhasad. I was born here, actually, and raised alongside Priest Glyvka. Believe it or not, I once thought this is place was haunted! So many strange noises, strange lights... But when I finally devoted myself to Einhasad, I found peace. Now I fear …

In order to use this system, you must have completed your 3rd class transfer, which means you must be level 76 or above. In addition, 1 Holy Pomander is required to learn each skill. If …

links.text: Cleanse the pomander to reset your skills.
Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/learn-lowl.text: In order to use the Skill Transfer system, you must be level 76 or higher and have completed your 3rd class transfer.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/cleanse-no.text: Do you really want to reset your transfer skills? You must use all your Holy Pomanders in order to use this service. After all, 10 million adena is a huge sum of money. Use the rest of your pomanders, then try your request again. Do not fret. I will make sure that all of the Holy Pomanders you used…
To reset the skill link requires 10 million Adena. In addition, your class must corresponding to the skill.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
